//: Fill these in from your Okta tenant. The application refuses to start while any REPLACE-ME remains.

Authentication.//Authority: The FULL issuer of your custom authorization server, including the aus... id. Not the bare org URL.
Authentication.//ClientId: The native app client id. Public, not a secret.
Authentication.//RedirectUri: Must match a redirect URI registered on the Okta app exactly. A private-use scheme like this one, or a loopback address such as http://127.0.0.1:8765/callback.
Authentication.//Scopes: offline_access is what earns a refresh token. Without it the user is asked to sign in again when the first access token expires.
Authentication.//Resources: The APIs this app calls. The key names the HttpClient.
